start: Workout running, Bench Press set 1 normal

steps.action: Tap the set number '1' ('Set 1. Change set type')
user_sees: Sheet 'Set type' with 'Normal set' (selected), 'Warm-up', 'Drop set', 'Failure' and 'Remove set'
must_not: RPE choices in this sheet
A Done button needed to apply

steps.action: Tap 'Warm-up'
user_sees: Sheet closes at once; the set number reads 'W'
must_not: The warm-up counted in working sets
Another set changed

start: Workout running, set 3 after a heavy set

steps.action: Tap the set number, tap 'Drop set'
user_sees: Number reads 'D'; the tick still starts the same rest
must_not: The rest skipped for a drop set

steps.action: Finish the workout
user_sees: Recap chip starts 'D '
must_not: The drop set shown as a normal set

steps.action: Tap the set number, tap 'Failure'
user_sees: Number reads 'F'
must_not: The set's numbers cleared

steps.action: Tap outside the sheet or press Back
user_sees: Sheet closes; the set type unchanged
must_not: The type changed
The set removed

steps.action: Tap the 'W', tap 'Normal set'
user_sees: Number back to '2'; counted again as a working set
must_not: It stays a warm-up
Its numbers lost

steps.action: Tap the number, tap 'Remove set'
user_sees: Set removed with an undo offer
must_not: The whole exercise removed
No way to undo

steps.action: Tap Undo
user_sees: The set back as it was
must_not: The set back as a different type

steps.action: Change a set type
user_sees: Kept with the workout on this phone
must_not: Anything shown to the gym because of the type
